name: Resolution
definition: Specifies an item in the agenda of the meeting. Some resolutions are submitted to the vote of the security holders, some are presented for information only.

IssuerLabel.name: Issuer Label
IssuerLabel.definition: Numbering of the resolution as specified by the issuer or  its agent.

Description.name: Description
Description.definition: Free text description of the resolution.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Indicates whether a resolution is ordinary, extraordinary or special.

ForInformationOnly.name: For Information Only
ForInformationOnly.definition: Indicates whether the resolution is listed for information or for voting.

SubmittedBySecurityHolder.name: Submitted By Security Holder
SubmittedBySecurityHolder.definition: Indicates whether the resolution has been submitted by the security holder.

ManagementRecommendation.name: Management Recommendation
ManagementRecommendation.definition: Indicates how the management of the issuing company wishes the security holders to vote.

NotifyingPartyRecommendation.name: Notifying Party Recommendation
NotifyingPartyRecommendation.definition: Indicates how the notifying party recommends that the security holders vote.

VoteOptions.name: Vote Options
VoteOptions.definition: Vote options allowed at the resolution level. When specified, it supersedes the vote options given for the meeting.

VoteType.name: Vote Type
VoteType.definition: Impact of vote results on an agenda resolution.

VotingRightsThresholdForApproval.name: Voting Rights Threshold For Approval
VotingRightsThresholdForApproval.definition: Voting rights threshold required in percentage or in quantity to have the resolution approved.

ThresholdBasis.name: Threshold Basis
ThresholdBasis.definition: Nature of the quantity used as a basis to set a threshold for voting on resolutions at general meetings.

CastVotes.name: Cast Votes
CastVotes.definition: Specifies whether a resolution is accepted or not and details the number of votes and their status.

Meeting.name: Meeting
Meeting.definition: Meeting for which an agenda item is specified.
